DEFAULT_MAIL_DOMAIN.description: Default DNS mail domain. Usually commented out in the file but parametrized here for potential uncommenting.

DEFAULT_MAIL_HOST.description: Default mail host. Usually commented out in the file but parametrized here for potential uncommenting.

EXTENDED_SCHEMA.description: Turn on extended schema support (e.g., for person objects).

USE_UTF8.description: Use UTF8 encoding. Comment out if LDAP server does not support UTF8.

IGNORE_UID_BELOW.description: Ignore system users with UID below this value.

IGNORE_GID_BELOW.description: Ignore system groups with GID below this value.

IGNORE_UID_ABOVE.description: Ignore system users with UID above this value.

IGNORE_GID_ABOVE.description: Ignore system groups with GID above this value.
